sloka: स ज्वालापरिवारस्तु निर्दहन्निव राक्षसम् ।तेन स्पृष्टो बलवता महाप्रहरणो ऽस्फुरत् ।। ७.२२.३६ ॥
transliteration: sa jvālāparivārastu nirdahanniva rākṣasam ।tena spṛṣṭo balavatā mahāpraharaṇo 'sphurat ।। 7.22.36 ॥

translations.english: What more can be said of one who is touched or struck down, when merely by sight it draws away the lives of living beings?
